policy: A documented crop is named in a cited Moroccan Ministry source. Region entries mean the source explicitly names that administrative region for the crop or crop group; an empty region list means region-specific availability is unknown, not absent. Simulator values are prototype assumptions, not validated crop-water or agronomic data.

sources.title: Filière Céréalière
sources.evidence: Official national cereal-sector profile; historical indicators are mainly for 2015–2019.

sources.title: Production définitive des céréales principales au titre de la campagne agricole 2025-2026
sources.evidence: Names soft wheat, durum wheat and barley nationally; regional shares are for cereal area/production in aggregate, not for individual cereal species.

sources.title: Filière Agrumicole
sources.evidence: Names clementines, Maroc-Late and navels and reports citrus area by five named administrative regions plus an unallocated 'other regions' share.

sources.title: Filière Arboricole
sources.evidence: Documents national stone-fruit, pome-fruit and rustic-fruit groups; its regional breakdown is for arboriculture overall, not these individual groups.

sources.title: Filière Arganier
sources.evidence: Names Souss-Massa, Marrakech-Safi and Guelmim-Oued Noun as the main production regions.

sources.title: Filière Oléagineuse
sources.evidence: Names sunflower and rapeseed; reports their main areas and rapeseed development areas.

sources.title: Filière Oléicole
sources.evidence: Documents olive production nationally, presence in ten regions, and identifies Fès-Meknès and Marrakech-Safi as 54% of olive area; it does not name the other eight regions.

sources.title: Filière Maraîchère de primeurs
sources.evidence: Documents the early-vegetable group nationally and names four regions for its production share; it does not identify individual vegetable species in the text.

sources.title: Région Rabat-Salé-Kénitra
sources.evidence: The regional profile names lentille d'Ain Sbit and lentille de Zaer as regional products; this documents lentil presence but not a crop calendar or agronomic suitability.

sources.title: Filière Palmier dattier
sources.evidence: Documents date-palm production and reports its area by four named administrative regions.

sources.title: Filière Rose à parfum
sources.evidence: Documents perfume-rose production in the Dadès valley of Drâa-Tafilalet.

sources.title: Filière Rizicole
sources.evidence: Documents rice production, located mainly in the Gharb and Loukkos plains; these are not administrative-region assignments.

sources.title: Filière Safran
sources.evidence: Documents saffron and names Souss-Massa and Drâa-Tafilalet as its main production regions.

sources.title: Filière Sucrière
sources.evidence: Names sugar beet and sugar cane; production areas are given as irrigation perimeters, not administrative regions.

crops.name: Cereals (crop group)
crops.evidence_note: The Ministry reports that these four regions together account for about 75% of cereal area; this is aggregate evidence, not crop-specific regional availability.

crops.name: Winter wheat (prototype option)
crops.evidence_note: Wheat is documented nationally, but the cited source does not identify a winter-wheat type or provide wheat-specific regional evidence.

crops.name: Soft wheat
crops.evidence_note: Named in the Ministry's 2025–2026 national cereal production report; region-specific species data are not supplied.

crops.name: Durum wheat
crops.evidence_note: Named in the Ministry's 2025–2026 national cereal production report; region-specific species data are not supplied.

crops.name: Barley
crops.evidence_note: Named in the Ministry's 2025–2026 national cereal production report; regional shares are reported for cereals in aggregate.

crops.name: Faba beans
crops.evidence_note: Present in the prototype simulator, but national cultivation evidence has not yet been added to this catalog.

crops.name: Chickpeas
crops.evidence_note: Present in the prototype simulator, but national cultivation evidence has not yet been added to this catalog.

crops.name: Lentils
crops.evidence_note: The Ministry's regional profile names lentille d'Ain Sbit and lentille de Zaer. This supports lentil presence in Rabat-Salé-Kénitra only; simulator values remain unvalidated.

crops.name: Sunflower
crops.evidence_note: The Ministry names sunflower among the oilseeds mainly located in Rabat-Salé-Kénitra and Fès-Meknès. Prototype rotation scores are not locally validated.

crops.name: Rapeseed
crops.evidence_note: The Ministry reports oilseeds mainly in Rabat-Salé-Kénitra and Fès-Meknès, and rapeseed development in Casablanca-Settat and Béni Mellal-Khénifra.

crops.name: Sugar beet
crops.geographic_note: The Ministry lists the Gharb, Doukkala, Tadla, Loukkos and Moulouya irrigation perimeters; these are not administrative-region assignments.
crops.evidence_note: Named by the Ministry as one of the two crops underpinning the Moroccan sugar sector.

crops.name: Sugar cane
crops.geographic_note: The Ministry lists the Gharb, Doukkala, Tadla, Loukkos and Moulouya irrigation perimeters; these are not administrative-region assignments.
crops.evidence_note: Catalogued as a perennial crop and excluded from annual rotation selection.

crops.name: Rice
crops.geographic_note: The Ministry locates rice mainly in the Gharb and Loukkos plains; exact administrative-region availability is not mapped.
crops.evidence_note: National production is documented, but the prototype has no validated rice rotation coefficients.

crops.name: Fallow (management practice)
crops.evidence_note: Fallow is a land-management option, not a crop, and is not selectable in the crop catalog or annual crop rotation.
